posts.author: thsottiaux
posts.text: 我们今天为 dots 发布了一些不错的更新，banked 重置卡已经激活，应该很快会到每个人的账户里！
posts.originalText: We shipped some good updates to dots today and the banked reset has been activated and should land in everyones accounts sometime soon!
posts.fullText: 我们今天为 dots 发布了一些不错的更新，banked 重置卡已经激活，应该很快会到每个人的账户里！
posts.fullOriginalText: We shipped some good updates to dots today and the banked reset has been activated and should land in everyones accounts sometime soon!

context.author: ChatGPT
context.text:
你的 dot 现在可以……

⚡️ 更快的回复
💬 更少的术语
🫡 更好的跟进执行

而且，它们现在可以遵循你的自定义指令。在对话串里告诉你的 dot 诸如该如何表现，或哪些操作需要你先批准。

“始终用小写说话。”
“发送任何邮件前先给我看草稿。”

你也可以在移动端的 Customize > Behavior 中，或通过网页端和桌面端 dot 的菜单，设置自定义指令和规则。
context.originalText:
Your dot now has…

⚡️ Faster replies
💬 Less jargon
🫡 Better follow-through

And, they can now follow your custom instructions. Tell your dot in the thread things like how to behave or which actions need your go-ahead.

“always talk in lowercase.”
“Show me a draft before sending any emails.”

You can also set custom instructions and rules in Customize > Behavior on mobile, or through your dot’s menu on web and desktop.

activities.text: @ForwardEditor 我们曾犹豫要不要把 https://x.com 嵌进 codex 应用里，好搞明白那些重置是怎么回事，但最后还是决定不做。

context.author: ForwardEditor
context.text: 我觉得，要想对 AI 的动向有任何一点头绪，就必须得有个 X 账号；而且我也搞不懂，你的 Codex 用量为什么老是莫名其妙地被重置。
context.originalText: I feel like it's necessary to have an X account to have ANY clue what's going on with AI and also why tf your Codex usage keeps getting reset randomly
